name: @cms/media
description: Pluggable media BlobStore and governed pipeline contracts for the handoff CMS. Owns the governed projection of tenant-qualified, namespace-scoped, privacy-sanitized media objects; canonical content/assets remain host-owned. Provides local filesystem and injected S3-compatible BlobStore implementations, image media field contracts (peer en/es alt, decorative handling, focal/crop, responsive variants, ICC-preserved and privacy-EXIF-stripped attestation), and a read-only video model. V1: video reads are supported, writes are forbidden.
